data.text: [00:04]Well … something really frightening happened to me the other day. `[00:09.8]I had a really unusual – and frightening journey – going from London to Paris. `[00:16]I’d got a really good last-minute deal and I was going for the weekend with my wife. `[00:21.8]Anyway, it started off badly when our flight was suddenly cancelled and so obviously we were quite annoyed about that. `[00:30.2]It was really annoying because we were only going for a short time. `[00:35]But then they said there was another flight we could go on … which was only twenty minutes after our cancelled flight. `[00:42]So, we all got on the flight and nothing happened really until we got to Paris.

[00:48]And then, just as we were coming in to land, … it’s hard to believe, but suddenly we started climbing again. `[00:56]The wheels were almost touching the ground I think … and the engines came on very, very … very, very loud and we started climbing violently. `[01:08]There was no announcement from the captain. `[01:11]And then the engines went quiet again and then we climbed again violently and then we went sideways and then we went another way and then we climbed again and … believe it or not, this went on for about five minutes – maybe longer. `[01:27.3]Actually, it felt like about half an hour, but it was probably about five minutes.

[01:32.3]After a while, the plane started flying normally again and then the captain made an announcement and apologised. `[01:39.8]It’s incredible, I know, but a lorry had been on the runway. `[01:45]He said that a lorry had been in the middle of the runway … and he had had to take off again in order to avoid it. `[01:52.9]Well, what a journey! Thankfully, we had a really good weekend in Paris, and the flight back was fine!
